name: MTOS — Intake-to-Med-Recs pipeline orchestration
_description: Deterministic Intake-to-Med-Recs pipeline (Task #168). The CRM owns the state machine (leads.pipeline_status + pipeline_events); this workflow is the ORCHESTRATOR that sequences the stages which need an external nudge, via CRM callbacks under /api/pipeline. Subscribe to event: lead.created. Requires an API key with scopes automations:view + automations:execute. The intake→NPI step is driven here; bg-check, e-sign-signed and inbound-fax stages are inherently event-driven and arrive at the CRM directly via /api/webhooks/{bgcheck,dropbox-sign,docusign,inbound-fax/:provider} — this workflow reads their result rather than forcing it, and never fabricates a stage that did not actually happen.

parameters.responseBody: ={ "ok": true, "lead_id": $('Extract lead + provider fields').item.json.lead_id, "npi_verdict": "VERIFIED", "next": "Awaiting e-sign packet completion. The signed envelope arrives at /api/webhooks/{dropbox-sign,docusign}; the CRM fans out to DOCS_SIGNED → HIPAA_FAXED → AWAITING_MED_RECS automatically. Inbound med-records fax lands at /api/webhooks/inbound-fax/:provider and completes the pipeline. No further orchestration needed here." }
